gloss: lawful wife (of a lord or noble)

definitions.gloss: lawful wife; principal wife (of a lord or noble)
definitions.explanation: Historical: the official wife of a feudal lord, shogun or noble, as distinct from the concubines. Common in historical dramas and history writing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{将軍|しょうぐん}→将軍：12386_shougun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{正室|せいしつ}。
{正室|せいしつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧がいなかった。
examples.english: His lawful wife had no children.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大名|だいみょう}→大名：10378_daimyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{正室|せいしつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人質|ひとじち}→人質：09678_hitojichi⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{江戸|えど}→江戸：19369_edo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}む→住む：00673_sumu⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}められた→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: The lawful wives of the daimyo were required to live in Edo as hostages.

notes:
⟦{正|せい}→正：09511_sei⟧ (proper, official) + ⟦{室|しつ}→室：09946_shitsu⟧ (room; wife).
